title: 選擇性焊接與回焊控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究潤濕、熱曲線與焊點形成；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate wetting, thermal profiles and joint formation. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「材料與界面」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for materials and interfaces.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「選擇性焊接與回焊控制」的「合金與液相：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「訊號診所：雜訊與錯頻」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Alloy and liquidus: model and design” in “Selective soldering and reflow control”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Signal Clinic: Noise and Aliasing” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「合金與液相」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for alloy and liquidus?
options: 所有無鉛焊料具有完全相同熔點。
固相線和液相線與合金有關，不能把所有焊料視為同一熔點。
增加助焊劑量永遠沒有副作用。
optionsEn: All lead-free solders have identical melting points.
Solidus and liquidus depend on alloy; solders do not share one melting point.
Adding more flux never has side effects.

quiz.explanationEn: Solidus and liquidus depend on alloy; solders do not share one melting point. Check alloy and phase-change range in material records.

steps.title: 合金與液相：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Alloy and liquidus: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「合金與液相」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。

steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Check alloy and phase-change range in material records. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Solidus and liquidus depend on alloy; solders do not share one melting point.” with the hypothesis to reject “All lead-free solders have identical melting points.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.

steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Check alloy and phase-change range in material records. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 對照材料證明中的合金與相變範圍。

Compare the supported mechanism “Contact angle, surface energy and pad geometry affect solder distribution.” with the hypothesis to reject “Equal solder volume guarantees identical joint shape.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：比較相同體積在不同表面狀態的形狀。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare equal volume on different surface conditions. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 比較相同體積在不同表面狀態的形狀。
steps.observationEn: Compare equal volume on different surface conditions.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：焊料體積相同就保證焊點形狀相同。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Equal solder volume guarantees identical joint shape. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits
knowledge.text: 簡化熱量 Q=mcpΔT；實際相變另需潜熱。 定比熱與均溫假設；不可作為實際爐溫或焊接時間配方。
knowledge.textEn: Simplified sensible heat Q=mcpΔT; phase change additionally needs latent heat. Constant heat capacity and uniform temperature; not an oven-temperature or soldering-time recipe.

quiz.question: 審查「潤濕與幾何」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for wetting and geometry?
options: 焊料體積相同就保證焊點形狀相同。
比較相同體積在不同表面狀態的形狀。
最快升溫一定能改善所有焊點。
optionsEn: Equal solder volume guarantees identical joint shape.
Compare equal volume on different surface conditions.
Fastest heating necessarily improves every joint.
